name: deadbolt
description: Read-only setup guidance and bundle verification; explicit configuration enables the local MCP tool-call gate.
long_description: With no operator configuration, exposes only read-only integration guidance and packaged-engine checksum verification. Setup mode forwards no tools, accesses no accounts and provides no active protection. Supplying an absolute operator configuration path switches to the trusted downstream server and explicit policy gate; setup tools are then replaced by the downstream tool list. Invalid supplied configuration stops startup. Bundles stable DeadBolt v1.0.3, not candidate exact-action features. Operator approvals, pause and kill remain local CLI actions, never agent tools. Gates routed tools/call requests; startup, non-tool methods and arbitrary OS access remain outside this boundary. The downstream server remains trusted. No sandbox or compliance certification. Node.js 20+ required; Mac ARM64/Intel, Linux x64 and Windows x64 included.

operator_config.title: Operator configuration
operator_config.description: Leave blank for read-only setup guidance (no active protection). To gate a trusted downstream server, enter the absolute path to your private operator JSON defining explicit tool policy and state paths. Invalid supplied configuration stops startup.

tools.name: deadbolt_get_integration_guide
tools.description: Get local, read-only DeadBolt setup steps for a supported integration route. Returns operator responsibilities, a placeholder configuration and the enforcement boundary. Does not create files, run a server or grant permission. Available only when operator configuration is blank.

tools.name: deadbolt_check_bundle
tools.description: Read the bundled engine and provenance metadata, calculate its SHA-256 and report compatibility and packaging integrity for this host. Reads only this installed bundle; does not execute the engine, inspect operator state or test security. Available only when operator configuration is blank.
